El Data Steward vela por la calidad, met: The Data Steward looks after the quality, metadata and consistency of the data to ensure it complies with the organization's policies.
El Degaussing NO funciona en unidades de: Degaussing does NOT work on solid-state drives (SSD, NVMe or flash memory) because they have no magnetic platters.
El Director Financiero (CFO) recibe un c: The Chief Financial Officer (CFO) receives an email that appears to come from their main server vendor: "Dear CFO, due to a bank audit, we ask that upcoming invoices be wired to our new IBAN account attached. We appreciate your prompt handling".

The IPS generates many false positives.
El IPS/IDS registra lo sospechoso. Tramp: The IPS/IDS logs what is suspicious. Trap: IPs, ports and timestamps of ALL connections are in the firewall.

El MOA es más formal y detallado que el: The MOA is more formal and detailed than the MOU: it defines specific responsibilities and conditions.

El MSA establece los términos generales;: The MSA sets the general terms; each specific job is defined later in a SOW.
El Modelo de Responsabilidad Compartida: The cloud Shared Responsibility Model defines which security controls are the obligation of the Cloud Service Provider (CSP) and which belong to the Customer in each of the three service models: IaaS (Infrastructure as a Service, e.g. AWS EC2), PaaS (Platform as a Service, e.g. Azure App Services) and SaaS (Software as a Service, e.g. Microsoft 365). El NAVEGADOR DE LA VÍCTIMA envía la peti: The VICTIM'S BROWSER sends the request = CSRF. The attacker uses the stolen session = hijacking.
El NDA protege la confidencialidad de la: The NDA protects the confidentiality of the shared information.

The mandatory sequence is: 1. CPU registers and cache, 2. Main RAM (routing tables, ARP cache, running processes, active network connections), 3. Swap / paging file / hibernation files, 4. Local storage media (hard drive / SSD), 5. Removable media (USB/tapes) and 6. Remote logs / cloud backup media.
El Orden de Volatilidad RFC 3227 es una: The RFC 3227 Order of Volatility is one of the fixed questions in CompTIA Security+: 1. CPU registers/cache -> 2. RAM (active connections and processes) -> 3. Swap/Pagefile -> 4. Local hard drive -> 5. Remote logs -> 6. Tapes/optical media. A write blocker is mandatory so atime/mtime are not modified.
El PDP nunca procesa el tráfico de datos: The PDP never processes application data traffic directly; it only issues authorization directives to the PEP.
El Policy Administrator ejecuta la decis: The Policy Administrator executes the engine's decision: it creates or tears down the communication path.
El SIEM detecta que 80 estaciones de tra: The SIEM detects that 80 workstations communicate with identical patterns exactly every 60 seconds to domains with random names (.xyz, .top). Suddenly, all the machines flood an external competitor's IP with SYN traffic.
El SIEM recopila telemetría de todas las: The SIEM collects telemetry from every zone, but its console and central storage live in the secure management network/internal LAN.
El SLA admite como máximo 2 horas de ind: The SLA allows at most 2 hours of unavailability of the transactional service per incident.
El SLA define métricas de servicio medib: The SLA defines measurable service metrics (uptime, response times) and penalties.
The SLA tolerates 2 hours: RTO < 2 h.
El SOC está rediseñando su plataforma de: The SOC is redesigning its monitoring platform. The operations lead needs a table that maps each need to the right tool and each daily team task to the matching monitoring activity.
El SOC recibió una alerta de uso de CPU: The SOC received an alert of 100% CPU usage on server web01 and outbound connections to an unknown IP. You have a root console on the server. El SOW/Work Order describe el alcance es: The SOW/Work Order describes the specific scope of a project under the MSA.

El WAF (Web Application Firewall) opera: The WAF (Web Application Firewall) operates only at Layer 7 (HTTP/S) and must be placed in the DMZ or in front of the Web Servers, NEVER at the bare edge replacing the NGFW.

El WAF inspecciona Capa 7 (HTTP/HTTPS) c: The WAF inspects Layer 7 (HTTP/HTTPS) against SQLi and XSS. The IPS covers general network Layers 3/4/7. Do not confuse their positions in the DMZ.
El WAF protege aplicaciones web (capa 7): The WAF protects web applications (layer 7) and sits immediately in front of the web servers.

El acceso al portal de nómina se concede: Access to the payroll portal is granted if department = Finance AND device = managed AND country = Argentina.

El analista de turno recibe una notifica: The on-shift analyst receives a real-time notification when the "impossible travel" rule fires.

El análisis de comportamiento en tiempo: Real-time behavioral analysis (EDR) and sandbox emulation are essential to detect this malware when it runs in memory.

El análisis de impacto se hace ANTES; la: Impact analysis happens BEFORE; rollback is the way out when the change already failed.
El análisis de malware y la identificaci: Malware analysis and identifying indicators of compromise (IoC) on endpoints is one of the most tested skills in CompTIA Security+ Domain 2 (SY0-701, Objective 2.4). Modern threats combine complex evasion techniques: ransomware destroys Windows shadow copies (vssadmin delete shadows) before encrypting with strong cryptography (AES/RSA) to force payment; Remote Access Trojans (RATs) disguise themselves as legitimate utilities and open an interactive reverse C2 channel; kernel rootkits (Ring 0) hook the service dispatch table (SSDT) to become invisible to Task Manager and user tools; spyware/infostealers capture keystrokes (GetAsyncKeyState) and browsers' SQLite databases; and fileless malware (Fileless/LotL) injects Base64-encoded scripts into native system processes without touching the hard drive.

Windows event identifiers (Event IDs) are standard in CompTIA: Event ID 4625 is a failed logon, Event ID 4624 is a successful logon, and Event ID 4740 indicates an account lockout due to too many failed attempts. Hundreds of 4625 events within seconds signal a brute-force or password spraying attack.

HSTS (HTTP Strict Transport Security) with the "includeSubDomains" and "preload" directives forces browsers to use HTTPS exclusively, preventing SSL stripping downgrade attacks. CSP (Content Security Policy) restricts the origin of scripts and stylesheets through cryptographic nonces, neutralizing XSS injections. X-Frame-Options in DENY mode prevents clickjacking attacks. TLS 1.3 with PFS cipher suites guarantees maximum confidentiality.

El blue team defiende; el red team ataca: The blue team defends; the red team attacks.

El comité de riesgos revisa su vocabular: The risk committee reviews its vocabulary before the audit. Choose the term for each statement.
El comité técnico compara arquitecturas: The technical committee compares architectures for new projects. Choose the model or consideration each statement describes.
El compromiso futuro de una clave de lar: A future compromise of a long-term key must not allow decrypting past sessions.
El conocimiento exhaustivo de los puerto: Thorough knowledge of network ports and protocols (Objectives 3.2 and 4.5 of CompTIA Security+ SY0-701) is a skill that is tested very often. Next, each device is recorded on the Chain of Custody form. Physical acquisition is performed using a Hardware Write Blocker to ensure the operating system does not modify the MACB metadata (Modified, Accessed, Created, Born). La infraestructura de clave pública (PKI: Public key infrastructure (PKI) and X.509 certificate management are the core of digital trust in CompTIA SY0-701. Certificate revocation must balance security and performance: traditional Certificate Revocation Lists (CRL) are bulky files downloaded periodically, while OCSP (Online Certificate Status Protocol) queries the CA in real time but can suffer latency and leak user privacy; the optimal solution is therefore OCSP Stapling (RFC 6066), where the web server queries and caches the CA's stamped response and sends it in the TLS handshake. As for formats: .PFX/.P12 is binary and stores the private key with a password; .PEM is Base64 ASCII; .DER is pure binary; and the SAN extension protects multiple domain names (FQDNs) under a single certificate. For recovering encrypted keys, Key Escrow with M-of-N control ensures no single custodian can decrypt data unilaterally.
La ingeniería social explota vulnerabili: Social engineering exploits vulnerabilities in human psychology instead of software flaws. CompTIA SY0-701 rigorously tests the six principles of persuasion identified by Robert Cialdini: Authority (impersonating figures of power such as the CEO or the police), Urgency (time pressure to block critical thinking), Scarcity (an exclusive or limited opportunity), Familiarity/Liking (building rapport or pretending to be a colleague), Consensus/Social Proof (making people believe everyone else already did it) and Intimidation (threats of punishment or dismissal). For each attack vector there is an official technical and procedural countermeasure.
La integridad se verifica comparando has: Integrity is verified by comparing hashes with a trusted baseline (FIM: AIDE, Tripwire).

La restauración la realiza el sistema de: The restore is performed by the backup system (technical) and reverses the damage after the incident (corrective).

La segmentación tradicional por VLANs a: Traditional VLAN segmentation on Layer 2 switches is too coarse and does not stop lateral movement within the same broadcast domain.
La seguridad de redes inalámbricas corpo: Corporate wireless security requires eliminating pre-shared keys (PSK) because of their vulnerability to 4-way handshake capture and offline dictionary attacks. The standard solution in CompTIA SY0-701 is WPA3-Enterprise 192-bit mode (Suite-B) with 802.1X EAP-TLS authentication, where both the RADIUS server (UDP ports 1812/1813) and the client authenticate each other with X.509 digital certificates without relying on passwords. For personal networks, WPA3 replaces the handshake with SAE (Dragonfly). Evil twins are actively neutralized with wireless intrusion prevention systems (WIPS).
La seguridad en el desarrollo de softwar: Secure software development (SDLC) and the protection of microservices and REST APIs are central topics in CompTIA Security+ Domains 2 and 4 (SY0-701, Objectives 2.3 and 4.1). Modern APIs are the main attack surface of cloud applications, where frontend controls are completely useless. CompTIA tests the ability to analyze HTTP/cURL requests, JSON payloads and code snippets to identify OWASP API Security Top 10 vulnerabilities: Broken Object Level Authorization (BOLA/IDOR), Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) aimed at cloud instance metadata services (169.254.169.254), JSON Web Token (JWT) forgery by accepting the "none" algorithm, SQL injection through unprotected REST parameters and the absence of rate limiting, enabling massive credential stuffing and denial of service attacks.
La seguridad física se diseña en capas,: Physical security is designed in layers, from the perimeter to the rack, and it must also protect equipment from the environment (fire, heat, emanations).
La ubicación de un control depende del t: Where a control goes depends on the traffic it must see and what it must protect. Think of it as layers from the Internet inward: the edge filters network attacks, the DMZ protects public servers at the application level, a boundary separates the DMZ from the LAN, and critical services (authentication, administration) stay in internal, controlled zones.

La ventana entre COMPROBAR y USAR = TOCT: The window between CHECK and USE = TOCTOU (a type of race condition).

La ventana es CUÁNDO se hace el cambio;: The window is WHEN the change happens; downtime is the service being down.
La versión más moderna del protocolo TLS: The most modern version of the TLS protocol. It uses ephemeral Diffie-Hellman key exchange (ECDHE), ensuring that if the server's private key is compromised in the future, past sessions cannot be decrypted.
La víctima recibe miles de respuestas DN: The victim receives thousands of DNS responses to queries it never made; they were sent with its spoofed IP.
Las ACL se procesan en orden numérico es: ACLs are processed in strict numerical order; once a packet matches a rule, it is applied and evaluation stops.
Las API keys estáticas no expresan el co: Static API keys do not express user consent and do not expire.
Las CA intermedias (o emisoras) emiten l: Intermediate (issuing) CAs issue the day-to-day certificates and protect the root, which stays offline.
Las CRL son listas grandes que se descar: CRLs are large lists downloaded periodically; direct OCSP exposes the client's browsing to the CA.
Las Operaciones de Seguridad modernas (S: Modern Security Operations (SOC), SIEM detection engineering and security orchestration, automation and response (SOAR) are the core of CompTIA Security+ Domain 4 (SY0-701, Objectives 4.4 and 4.7). Given massive volumes of event telemetry (Active Directory, Sysmon, EDR, NGFW, cloud IdP and proxy logs), manual intervention is too slow to stop destructive attacks in real time. CompTIA tests how to write effective SIEM correlation rules (based on time thresholds, event sequences and geographic anomalies) and how to tie them to pre-approved SOAR playbooks that run automatic corrective actions through APIs (network isolation, token revocation, dynamic perimeter blocking and account remediation), drastically reducing Mean Time to Detect (MTTD) and Respond (MTTR).

Las Tecnologías de Mejora de la Privacid: Privacy-Enhancing Technologies (PETs) let organizations use and share valuable information while minimizing the exposure of sensitive personal data (PII/PHI). In CompTIA Security+ SY0-701 it is vital to understand each technique's degree of reversibility and mechanism: Tokenization replaces critical data with random tokens through a secure store (Token Vault) to reduce PCI-DSS scope; Static Masking irreversibly replaces data in non-production environments (Dev/QA); Dynamic Masking alters the display on the fly in user queries without changing the actual storage; Anonymization permanently unlinks the data by removing direct and indirect identifiers with no possibility of re-identification (freeing it from GDPR); and Pseudonymization replaces identifiers but keeps a separate key for re-identification in clinical emergencies.
Las aplicaciones consultan el Active Dir: The applications query Active Directory over an encrypted channel.
Las aplicaciones legadas limitan qué cam: Legacy applications limit which security changes can be applied and require special consideration.
Las apps móviles y SPA obtienen así una: Mobile apps and SPAs thus obtain a verifiable identity.
Las balizas periódicas sincronizadas hac: Periodic synchronized beacons to DGA domains to launch coordinated attacks identify a botnet. It is remediated by implementing DNS sinkholing to redirect the malicious traffic, blocking the C2 on the firewall and disinfecting with EDR.
Las bombas lógicas no se replican por sí: Logic bombs do not replicate themselves or infect other machines; their damage is limited to the environment where they were planted.
Las cadenas de la regla describen artefa: The rule's strings describe artifacts characteristic of the malware.
Las campañas de phishing simulado miden: Simulated phishing campaigns measure and train recognition skills.
Las carpetas con datos sensibles deben r: Folders with sensitive data must break inheritance so they do not receive broad permissions from the parent folder.
Las claves de cifrado deben poder recupe: Encryption keys must be recoverable without any single person having full control.
Las consolas de administración VTY y los: The VTY management consoles and the Cisco Catalyst switch panels run over Telnet on port 23 and HTTP web on port 80. The "enable" credentials and network passwords travel in unencrypted plaintext.
Las consultas DNS salientes solo deben d: Outbound DNS queries must only go to the corporate resolvers 10.0.0.53 and 10.0.0.54.
Las consultas de nombres de dominio y re: Domain name queries and responses travel in plaintext over UDP 53 without cryptographic signature validation, which allows cache poisoning attacks (DNS cache poisoning) and browsing surveillance.
Las contraseñas de las cuentas de admini: Administrator account passwords are kept in a vault and rotated automatically after each use.
Las copias deben sobrevivir a la pérdida: The copies must survive the total loss of the primary site and the failure of one storage medium.
Las copias inmutables (WORM) o offline r: Immutable (WORM) or offline backups withstand ransomware with administrator credentials.
Las copias no pueden modificarse ni borr: Copies cannot be modified or deleted until the retention lock expires, not even by an administrator.
Las credenciales de la base de datos no: The database credentials must not end up in the image or in environment variables.
Las credenciales de la base de datos ya: The database credentials can no longer be read or modified from other accounts.
Las cuentas se crean al contratar a algu: Accounts are created when someone is hired and removed when they leave.
Las cuentas se crean automáticamente al: Accounts are created automatically when someone is hired and removed when they leave.
Las cámaras IP y los sensores IoT no per: IP cameras and IoT sensors do not allow installing software, so they are monitored by receiving their syslog and querying their API.
Las decisiones se reparten entre las uni: Decisions are distributed among the business units: decentralized governance.

Las entidades gubernamentales gobiernan: Government entities govern or oversee from outside the organization.
Las fechas de ls -la se falsifican fácil: The dates shown by ls -la are easily faked (timestomping).
Las herramientas del propio sistema no m: The system's own tools show nothing unusual, but there is unauthorized access.
Las imágenes con gestores de paquetes co: Images with full package managers (apt/yum) or bash shells increase the attack surface for attackers.
Las listas de control de acceso (ACL) de: Access control lists (ACLs) on stateful firewalls must follow the principle of least privilege and sequential "top-to-bottom" inspection. Each rule specifies Source, Destination, Protocol, Port and Action (PERMIT or DENY). The last mandatory rule on any secure firewall is the implicit Deny All (Implicit Deny / Drop Any Any), ensuring any traffic not explicitly authorized is blocked and logged.
Las macros con Mark of the Web (descarga: Macros with the Mark of the Web (downloaded from the Internet) must be blocked via GPO.
Las máquinas virtuales se crean o ajusta: Virtual machines are created or adjusted automatically based on business demand.
Virtual machines are created or adjusted automatically based on demand.
Las passkeys (FIDO2) eliminan la contras: Passkeys (FIDO2) eliminate the password. Trap: an OTP still has to be typed and can be stolen.
Las peticiones con comillas, ORDER BY y: Requests with quotes, ORDER BY and UNION SELECT (and the sqlmap agent) give the SQLi away.
Las peticiones de 192.0.2.66 a /products: The requests from 192.0.2.66 to /products.php?id= show the typical sqlmap progression.
Las peticiones del proxy cada 60 s exact: Proxy requests exactly every 60 s to random domains are the beaconing pattern.
Las pistas muestran feedback en vivo (me: Hints show live feedback (meters, option explanations, simulator). They do not exist on the real exam.
Las reglas PERMIT están encima del DENY: The PERMIT rules are above the final DENY and none of them opens too much.
Las reglas de detección combinan una acc: Detection rules combine an action with conditions. A good rule is specific (few false positives), resistant to trivial evasion and takes the right action for where the sensor sits: inline it can block, passive it can only alert.
Las reglas de entrada apuntan a la IP ex: Inbound rules point to the exact server IP and the exact service port.
Las reglas específicas van arriba; las g: Specific rules go at the top; general ones (DENY ANY ANY) at the bottom.

NIST SP 800-207 define los principios fu: NIST SP 800-207 defines the core principles of Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA): "Never trust, always verify". Implicit perimeters based on network location are removed. The architecture consists of the Control Plane (Policy Decision Point / Policy Engine - PDP/PE), which dynamically evaluates the context of the identity, device health and risk, and the Data Plane (Policy Enforcement Point - PEP), which enforces access at the micro-perimeter level. East-west lateral traffic is restricted through microsegmentation.
NIST SP 800-61 define el ciclo de vida d: NIST SP 800-61 defines the incident response lifecycle in 4 main phases: 1. Preparation, 2. Detection and Analysis, 3. Containment, Eradication and Recovery, and 4. Post-Incident Activity (Lessons Learned). CompTIA tests the strict logical sequence of these phases: a threat is never eradicated before its spread is contained, and services are never restored without removing persistence and the root cause.
